project.scope: research_only; not a YoloongPPT product runtime or dependency selection

nodes.purpose: Executable CLI entry into compiled src/index.ts.
Declares create flags, checks config, constructs provider, injects template/layout directories, and calls CreateCommand.
Validates provider/API-key config and resolves ~/.ai-agent-ppt/config.json; load returns null on any read/parse error.
Only deepseek and glm are constructed; other schema-accepted provider names throw not implemented.
Common chat API used by outline, content, and vision paths.
OpenAI SDK client configured for DeepSeek endpoint; remote service remains a black box.
Sends OpenAI-compatible HTTP request and supports multimodal user messages; remote service remains a black box.
Loads template, applies html > images > topic/input precedence, runs outline/fill/layout pipeline, and writes output.
Reads a file as UTF-8 or uses a topic; directory scan implementation is at lines 395-411 and only reads README.md/package.json.
Prompts for a 5-15 slide JSON outline and checks only JSON parse, title, and slides array.
Retries outline generation up to three attempts with 2/4 second delays.
Calls provider serially for slides and swallows each failure by keeping original slide data.
Loads and validates per-template template.json files.
Validates JSON layout and resolves template variables; load returns null on missing or invalid layout.
Maps title/subtitle/code/notes/image/bulletPoints to layout slots and creates StyleNode tree.
Flattens text/image nodes, adds decorations, and asks PptxGenJS to write the PPTX buffer.
Parses HTML at 1280x720, renders boxes through PPTAdapter, and writes a PptxGenJS buffer.
Reads images, calls vision provider, converts JSON/raw text to HTML, computes boxes, continues after per-image errors, then writes PPTX.
Supports a limited set of CSS selectors and transforms vision JSON into simplified HTML.
Parses simplified HTML and adapts npm purelayout output into LayoutBox records; additional geometry helpers are at lines 354-584.
Maps LayoutBox text/images/background to PptxGenJS slide methods.
No browser/page output pipeline was found in the pinned CLI/app source; located output routes write PPTX.

externalBlackBoxes.limit: Hosted model behavior and response generation are not in the repository.
The dependency's internal geometry algorithm is not source-grounded in this repository; local wrappers and flex corrections are mapped separately.
Third-party OOXML serialization and package-part construction are external.
Remote host response, redirects, and image availability are outside the source snapshot.

limitations: The two tested topic outputs use an injected fake provider with network disabled; hosted model output is untested.
Screenshot/Vision route is mapped from source but no real vision API call was made.
PPTX structure and slide text were checked; no Office/LibreOffice visual review or round-trip edit was performed.
Node 24.14.0 is a study-container observation, not a YoloongPPT runtime choice.
